pillar_reactions.evidence: The call ended inside discovery, before any pillar was delivered. The prospect asked for the format directly — 'is it like a live session, or will you just give a plan, I need to practice on my own, record myself, and then he will evaluate?' — and got a one-line answer, 'He will be there with you on the text', before the rep returned to questions.
Never presented. The only nutrition content delivered was an unprompted tip during discovery — 'First cut down, then bulk up' — which the prospect accepted without comment.
Never presented. The nearest reference was the rep's caveat that 'eventually, it's going to be on you to actually put in the work'.

anchors.raw: I had like four, five sessions... because I had these injuries, so I wanted to get the trainer so he could show me the right way of doing things
anchors.note: He has just bought a small block of in-person sessions for exactly the problem being sold against, and considers the job done for now — 'I need to practice what he has taught for at least three, six months'. Both a price reference and a live substitute, and neither was surfaced or challenged.

anchors.raw: previously I used to work out just at home, but then I joined the outside gym
anchors.note: A gym joined roughly a month ago that both he and his wife use and rate. His objection to it is the thirty-minute round trip, not the cost, so the incumbent spend is live and satisfactory.

anchors.raw: I ask, like, through AI, like, okay, how much, like, bowl of rice, calories in a bowl of rice and all that
anchors.note: Nutrition is currently handled free by an AI and training discovery by YouTube. He also found the programme itself through YouTube. The baseline he is comparing against costs nothing.

anchors.raw: But he has any certifications or anything? — Not 100% sure, actually.
anchors.note: Not a price anchor in the usual sense but it functions as one. A prospect explicitly evaluating providers was told the seller does not know whether the coach is certified, which lowers the defensible price of everything that follows.

unmet_demand.want: A straight answer on the coach's professional qualifications and certifications
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep did not know and the company appears not to have equipped him with an answer. What was offered instead — 1,200 clients and no visible complaints online — does not address the question asked.

unmet_demand.want: The programme format and price on request, so he could decide whether to continue
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The sales process withholds both until discovery is complete, by design. For a prospect running a vendor comparison rather than a transformation conversation, that design is a barrier rather than a filter.

He asked 'is he going to be there with me for the whole 40 minutes, one-on-one?' and was told no — support is asynchronous over text. The expectation the marketing set and what the product delivers are not the same thing here.

unmet_demand.want: Resolution of a three-to-four-month elbow and knee problem
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He bought personal training specifically for this and it did not fix it. The programme has no clinical screening or rehabilitation pathway, and the rep's response was a mechanism assertion — 'we need to strengthen the connective tissue there, make sure joints are aligned'.
